title: Diagnosis: evalf() fallback leaves reprec/imprec unbound when _eval_evalf returns a non-numeric expr (Max(0,y)); order-dependence is which arg hits the broken fallback first
evidence_refs: repro run: UnboundLocalError at evalf.py:1310 for Mul(Max(0,y),x) only
empirical: Max(0,y)._eval_evalf(20) -> Max(0,y); as_real_imag -> (Max(0,y), 0); re==0 False, re.is_number False, im==0 True -> reprec never assigned

code: evalf_symbol raises KeyError('subs') for symbols, caught by same except KeyError -> fallback; Symbol._eval_evalf returns None -> AttributeError -> NotImplementedError (clean bail); Function._eval_evalf returns self for non-numeric args (function.py:511 bad(m) path)

title: Fixed UnboundLocalError in evalf fallback: else-raise added after reprec/imprec chains; Mul(Max(0,y),x).evalf() now returns x*Max(0,y)
evidence_refs: repro run after edit: Mul(Max(0,y),x,evaluate=False).evalf() -> x*Max(0,y) (was UnboundLocalError at evalf.py:1310); 7-case sweep incl. Add/sin/sqrt/pi variants all clean
edit applied at sympy/core/evalf.py:1304-1305 and 1312-1313: else: raise NotImplementedError after both re and im chains
